housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of PLN 2,100 for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment in Toruń. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Torun Otodom says the usual deposit for a standard dwelling is one month of rent and identifies itself as the most popular Polish property service. Sources: https://www.otodom.pl/wiadomosci/kaucja-za-mieszkanie-wynajem/ https://www.otodom.pl/

banking.summary: PKO Bank Polski says a branch applicant should bring an ID card or passport. It also lists PESEL, contact and address data, and a foreign tax identification number when applicable. Source: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account
required_docs: foreign tax identification number if the applicant is a taxpayer of another country

schools.summary: SOKRATES International Schools in Toruń states that it is approved to offer Cambridge programmes from primary through secondary level. Source: https://sistorun.pl/en/liceum/o-szkole/uprawnienia/ The official Cambridge school directory is https://www.cambridgeinternational.org/why-choose-us/find-a-cambridge-school/?Location=Poland

legal_admin.summary: A foreign newcomer residing in Toruń registers temporary residence with the Toruń City Office Administrative Affairs Department, in person, electronically, or through an authorised representative, using the registration form, proof of title to the dwelling, and the applicable identity and residence document. Source: https://bip.torun.pl/sprawa-do-zalatwienia/pdf/27363/1
legal_admin.registration_step: Register temporary residence with the Toruń City Office Administrative Affairs Department; submit the temporary-residence form, proof of legal title to the dwelling, and the applicable passport, identity, visa, or residence document.

tax_finance.summary: The Ministry of Finance says a foreign employee living in Poland should obtain PESEL by applying to the competent municipal authority with documents confirming the application data; if PESEL is refused, the person may apply for NIP using form NIP-7. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/finanse/podaj-wlasciwy-pesel-lub-nip-pracownika

transport.summary: Miejski Zakład Komunikacji w Toruniu (MZK) operates the city network; the standard electronic or City Card monthly ticket for all day and night lines in zone I is PLN 108, while the resident-status price is PLN 98. Sources: https://www.mzk-torun.pl/aktualnosci/6296-zmiany-w-cenniku-biletow-mzk-18-10-2024 https://mzk-torun.pl/aktualnosci/6436-nizsze-ceny-dla-mieszkancow Valid EU/EFTA licences remain valid until expiry; the Polish exchange service is available after at least 185 days of residence. Sources: https://www.gov.pl/web/your-europe/acquiring-and-renewing-a-driving-licence https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie For public healthcare, register an S1 with the NFZ branch for the province of residence; a person without another insurance basis may instead sign a voluntary NFZ agreement and then register with ZUS. Sources: https://www.nfz.gov.pl/dla-pacjenta/medical-treatment-abroad/information-about-treatment-of-persons-from-euefta-member-states-in-poland/ https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EU/EFTA driving licence remains valid in Poland until expiry. A holder eligible for exchange after residing in Poland for at least 185 days applies at the city office in a city with county rights; non-convention licences require a theory test.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register an S1 document with the NFZ branch for the province of residence. If no other insurance basis applies, submit a voluntary-insurance application to the competent NFZ branch, sign the agreement, and register with the competent ZUS office within 7 days.
